caseNameFull: Air Reduction Co., Inc. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Harry W. Forbes for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Sewall Key and J. Louis Monarch for respondent. Messrs. Charles B. Mclnnis, Jacob Mertens, Jr., and G. Kibby Munson filed a brief on behalf of the Brown Shoe Co., Inc., as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
